processing: notch 50 Hz harmonics, band-pass 2-120 Hz, resampled to 240 Hz; good-channel common average reference; robust run standardisation (median, 1.4826 MAD); NLMS (mu 0.1, eps 0.001, weights N(0, 0.5), seed 0); trials overlapping BAD_high_amplitude excluded; rejection above 3 x median of the per-trial maximum; each epoch divided by its SD; mean over the trials of each run, then over runs in which the channel was good
onsets: speech events after >= 0.5 s of silence (overt, listening); covert trial onsets
